item.description:
## Changes
- Scrolling the Dashboard and Action items is smooth again in a big library; with a few hundred calls, Action items could stall for up to a second at a time. - Save Diagnostics… and Save Diagnostics Report… no longer freeze Ahoy while they build the zip (up to half a minute when old recordings had to come back from iCloud). - Starting or stopping a recording no longer pauses Ahoy for a moment while the chime plays. - On a call's screen, only one thing rewrites the insights at a time: Regenerate, Generate, Transcribe again, Ask and Translate now wait while another of them, or an assistant reply, is still running, so one can no longer silently overwrite the other.

## Changes
- Plugging in headphones or getting a Teams notification no longer starts a recording. - A Teams call that Ahoy recorded automatically now stops about 10 seconds after you hang up, instead of recording on. - An automatic recording now starts once a call app has used the microphone for about 3 seconds, so a short sound never starts one. The first few seconds of a detected call are not recorded. - FaceTime calls are no longer detected automatically. Start those with Start Recording.

## Changes
- While a summary waits for a transcription on this Mac to finish, the Insights card says so instead of "Generating…". - A summary that resumes on its own after Low Power Mode, heat or memory pressure can no longer be slowed by App Nap while the window is closed.
